newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: U.S. ICF KAISER SIGNS $160MLN CZECH MINI-MILL DEAL.
newsitem.headline: U.S. ICF KAISER SIGNS $160MLN CZECH MINI-MILL DEAL.

text.p: U.S. based ICF Kaiser International Inc signed on Friday a $160 million contract to provide engineering and construction services to complete a mini-mill project at the Czech steelworks Nova Hut a.s.

The contract is the second phase of a deal which began with an initial $102 million contract signed in March 1996 which provided management of the engineering and construction on the first phase of mill in northeastern Czech Republic.

"(Nova Hut) will adopt 100 percent continuous casting technology and build a new hot-rolled coil (HRC) mill with a capacity of one million tonnes per year," a statement issued at the signing ceremony said.
The project will be carried out as a "lump sum", turn-key contract by Kaiser's wholly-owned Dutch unit.
Nova Hut has said it plans to consume about half of the output of the mini-mill, and will sell the rest to Czech buyers or export it.

At the same signing ceremony, Nova Hut officials and the International Finance Corporation (IFC) signed a $250 million long-term credit package providing the Czech firm with funds to build the mini-mill.
